questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 6:10?
Find the wrong number in the series: 20, 30, 45, 50, 60, 70, 80
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 10, so 45 should be 40. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 3, 7, 14, 24, 37, …
questions.why: The differences go up by 3 each time (4, 7, 10, 13, 16). Next: 53. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A's mother is the only daughter of B's father. If B is a man, how is B related to A?
questions.why: B's father's only daughter is B's sister. She is A's mother, so B is A's maternal uncle.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 28, 37, 46, 55, 62, 73, 82
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 9, so 62 should be 64. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 36, 49, 62, 77, 88, 101, 114
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 13, so 77 should be 75. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If COUNTRY is written as ATVPWQE in a certain code, how is SILVER written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: SILVER → TGXNKU. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If SILVER is written as TGXNKU in a certain code, how is GARDEN written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: GARDEN → PGFTCI. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 9:45?
Ravi walks 4 m East, then turns right and walks 8 m, then turns right and walks 7 m. Which direction is Ravi facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the West. GPSC-style practice item.
